content.title: Protect yourselves where you are
content.summary: Make Drop, Cover, and Hold On automatic, including the seated way.

sources.label: Earthquake Country Alliance (Great ShakeOut) — Drop, Cover, and Hold On

skill.action: Drop onto your hands and knees, cover your head and neck, and hold on until the shaking stops. If you use a wheelchair or walker, lock your wheels, get as low as you can, and cover your head and neck.
skill.why: Ready.gov says: if you are inside, stay and do not run outside.
checkInPrompts: The floor starts shaking. What do you do?
An aftershock starts while you're checking the room. What now?

ifThen.template: If the ground shakes, we drop, cover and hold on. {who} checks {person} after.
